name: Dragonfly
description:
I'm a strategy and operations executive with 17+ years spent building and scaling businesses across fintech, regulatory advisory, and emerging technology ecosystems. I founded and led sendit.Money, a cross-border digital payments and remittance platform I built from the ground up, owning the full product, raising from institutional investors (including UK government-backed funding through Innovate UK), and building partnerships and infrastructure across five African markets. Before and alongside that, I spent seven years as Managing Director of a regulatory advisory firm working across government bodies in East and West Africa, and I currently sit as Chief Strategy Officer of a pan-African technology accelerator, where I mentor 200+ early-stage founders.

I co-lead ZuAfrique. Right now, I'm drawn to the post-AI world and the intersection of AI and human consciousness, using coordinated states and decentralised communities as a trust and coordination layer.  I've been experimenting at this intersection for the last 10 years, using the Humanlayer Framework to positively impact over 1,000 lives along the way.
